title: 保留与清理
implementation: internal/retention: Sweep enforces the expires_at facts writers persist, in LIMIT-ed chunks with one immediate transaction per batch (no long write locks)

durable events and system events: RC8 sse.durable_event_retention (7d) via expires_at; terminal commands kept 7d then removed with their idempotency records in the same transaction (RESTRICT foreign key); non-terminal commands are never swept
idempotency records: RC8 api.idempotency_retention (24h) via expires_at
stats: delegated to statsstore.Prune (raw 30d, hourly 180d per the RC8 stats block)

snapshots: completed snapshots older than the retention window (7d, OBS-03 policy decision) are removed unless they are the newest revision of their instance; files removed only when unreferenced and path-contained
artifacts: no-op in V1 - artifacts are re-downloaded into memory at dispatch time and never persisted (RC8 artifact_retention 24h applies to the V2 artifact plane)

checks.expires_at_enforcement: PASS: TestSweepEnforcesExpiresAtFacts - expired event/terminal command/idempotency removed; fresh rows and non-terminal commands survive
checks.batching: PASS: TestSweepBatchesDeletesUntilEmpty - BatchSize=2 with 5 expired rows deletes all across 3 batches
checks.snapshot_policy: PASS: TestSweepRemovesOldSnapshotsButKeepsLatestRevision - keeps the newest (generation, revision) per instance even when expired, removes older rows and their files
